remarks: Bright, spacious, immaculate 3-bedroom 1.5 bath townhome in the desirable West Rocks neighborhood. Tucked away on a cul-de-sac, yet close to all shopping and restaurants, and easily accessible to both I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.    14 Linden Street checks ALL the boxes with the convenience of in unit laundry, a lovely deck for enjoying outdoor space, and a dedicated driveway that can easily accommodate two cars.   With beautiful hardwood flooring throughout the main level, a finished lower level, currently used as an office/family room, this one is not to be missed! Schedule your showing today and make this wonderful place your new home!   NO smoking, 1 well-behaved pet considered on a case-by-case basis. Available January 1st. Good credit score a must!
